sources.excerpt: Official Crust Herndon homepage identifies Crust Pizzeria Napoletana at 360 Elden Street, Herndon, VA 20170, phone 703-817-2694, with current Sunday-Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday-Saturday hours.

Current restaurant-issued HTML menu exposes 35 food and nonalcoholic products across pizza, pasta, sandwiches, small plates, sweets, salad, and beverage sections, with ingredient descriptions but no allergen matrix.

Official-linked Chowly store 22589 exposes the complete current Herndon catalog: 58 raw product cards across seven categories. Two same-price Antonio pasta cards were consolidated as one product, yielding 57 canonical food and nonalcoholic products.
Official FAQ reiterates the exact Herndon address, hours, menu scope, and made-from-scratch food but contains no allergen, allergy, nutrition, or cross-contact disclosure.
Recent exact-address Grubhub storefront lists 360 Elden St and phone (703) 817-2694 and corroborates the seven-category Chowly catalog and its current descriptions.
Fresh official-domain searches for allergen, allergy, ingredients, nutrition, PDF, FAQ, sitemap, and cross-contact resources found no restaurant-issued allergen document.
Exact-brand and Herndon-targeted searches corroborated the official site, Chowly, and exact-address Grubhub menu but found no authoritative item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.

findings.summary: Official and exact-address ordering sources confirm the current Crust Pizzeria Napoletana operation at 360 Elden Street in Herndon.
The complete current Herndon food and nonalcoholic boundary contains 57 canonical products. All 43 frozen products remain current, and 14 current products were absent from the baseline.

Chowly exposes Antonio Special(pasta) and Antonio Special Pasta at the same price as adjacent pasta cards. They were consolidated into one canonical product while retaining the current heavy-cream description's direct milk evidence.

No comprehensive item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy was found after all four required searches. Only direct positive allergens supported by current names and ingredient descriptions were retained; no absence claims were inferred.
